item.coloph: 'di'i phyag len ma nor ci mchis pa/ 'od ldan 'bar mas khro gnyan rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ de nas rim gyis brgyud nas/ 'di'i phyag len ma nor ba bdag gis yi ger bkod/ 'gal 'khrul nor ba ci mchis pa/ bka' srung srid rgyal rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ snyan du brgyud pa 'di snying dang 'dra ba'i slob bu la ston/ de bas snying gi dkyil du sbos shig man ngag 'di nyams su len pa'i skyes bu ma gtogs pa'i/ kha khyer log lta can gyi rna ba ru/ tshig gcig tsam yang bsgrags gyur na/ srid pa rgyal mo'i bka' chad yod/ de phyir kun la ma bstan cig gdams pa 'di nyid la ma 'od ldan 'bar ma'i rgya gsum yod/ srid pa rgyal mo'i rgya dgu yod/ rgya 'di bshigs na rang gzhan gnyis ka srog rtsa gcod/ gsang rgya/ gab rgya/ sbas rgya/ 'od ldan 'bar ma'i rgya gsum yin/ rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya//
